VIOLATIONS (5)
  Root causes: 1 cluster covers 3 of 5 rows
    SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (Level AA) · ACT afw4f7, 09o5cg · axe: color-contrast (3 rows, one cause)
      cause: #999999 text on #ffffff: 2.84:1 against 4.5:1 required
      passes: default
      e.g. html > body > main > p:nth-child(1)
      fix: text darker → #767676 (ratio 4.54:1)
      or run: a11y-loop contrast "#999999" "#ffffff" --fix
      +2 more like this (--verbose lists them; --json has every row)
      https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.14/color-contrast
  Other rows (2)
    SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (Level AA) · ACT afw4f7, 09o5cg · axe: color-contrast
      · html > body > footer > p
        Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds. Fix any of the following: Element has insufficient color contrast of 2.16 (foreground color: #b0b0b0, background color: #ffffff)
        fix: text darker → #767676 (ratio 4.54:1)
      https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.14/color-contrast
    SC 2.1.1 Keyboard (Level A) · a11y-loop: keyboard-unreachable [inferred]
      · #late
        This element should be reachable by keyboard but never received focus during a Tab walk of 60 steps. Check for aria-hidden, display:none on focus, a focus trap earlier in the page, or tabindex="-1".
        confidence: reduced. The Tab walk used all 60 presses without wrapping, so elements after the last one it reached may be reachable and simply beyond the budget. Confirm by hand.

NEEDS REVIEW (1) — axe reported these as incomplete, or a11y-loop found something it cannot judge alone
  SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (Level AA) · ACT afw4f7, 09o5cg · axe: color-contrast
    · html > body > div.card > p  [only under: forced-colors]
      Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds. Fix any of the following: Element has insufficient color contrast of 1.23 (foreground color: #e8e6ef, background color: #ffffff)
      note: axe-core reads the foreground from -webkit-text-fill-color before color, and Chromium's forced-colors emulation forces color and the background but leaves -webkit-text-fill-color at the author's value, so this pass compares the author's foreground against the forced background. Light-on-dark text reads near 1:1 here whatever its real contrast. Confirm the pair in the default and dark passes, check forced colors by eye or with the OS setting, and do not apply a colour derived from this pair: it fails in the default pass.
      see: https://github.com/ChanMeng666/a11y-loop/blob/main/docs/overview.md#color-contrast-in-the-forced-colors-pass-is-usually-not-a-defect
    https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.14/color-contrast

MANUAL CHECKS (7) — automation cannot judge these
  · Test with a real screen reader (NVDA or JAWS on Windows, VoiceOver on macOS/iOS).
    why: No automated tool, and no simulator, reproduces real AT behaviour — NVDA, JAWS and VoiceOver diverge from each other and from the specification.
  · SC 2.4.3: Tab through the page and confirm the focus order is logical, not merely present.
    why: a11y-loop can see that focus moves and where it goes, but whether the sequence makes sense for this content is a human judgment.
  · SC 2.1.1: Complete the page’s main task using only the keyboard.
    why: Automated checks probe individual controls; they do not know what the user is trying to accomplish.
  · SC 2.4.4: Read each link text out of context and confirm the destination is still clear.
    why: SC 2.4.4 permits vague link text when the surrounding context supplies the purpose — whether it does is a judgment call.
  · SC 1.3.1: Confirm the heading structure describes the content hierarchy, not the visual sizes.
    why: Automation can detect skipped levels but not whether the outline reflects the actual structure of the page.
  · SC 1.4.1: Confirm colour is never the only way information is conveyed.
    why: SC 1.4.1 is one of the criteria no tool can test: recognising that "the required fields are in red" needs comprehension of the content.
  · SC 1.4.11: Check the contrast of hover and focus states.
    why: No engine checks state contrast unless the state is driven and re-scanned. Use --interact to add hover and focus states to the audit.

5 automatically detectable failures, 1 finding(s) needing review, 0 best-practice note(s).
The 1 needs-review finding(s) are not passes — see the NEEDS REVIEW section above, or the needsReview array in --json output.
